# lucidity_users (Data Source)

Lists the users on the caller's Lucidity account, optionally filtered. Lucidity staff accounts are not listed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every active user.
data "lucidity_users" "active" {
  status = "ACTIVE"
}

# Users holding the Editor role on any cloud account.
data "lucidity_users" "editors" {
  role = "Editor"
}

output "admin_emails" {
  value = [for u in data.lucidity_users.active.users : u.email if u.is_account_admin]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `email` (String) Only users whose email contains this text (case-insensitive).
- `role` (String) Only users holding this role on any cloud account.
- `status` (String) Only users with this status, e.g. `ACTIVE` or `DISABLED`. If not set, removed users are included as `DISABLED`.

### Read-Only

- `users` (Attributes List) The matching users. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users))

<a id="nestedatt--users"></a>
### Nested Schema for `users`

Read-Only:

- `email` (String) Email address; identifies the user.
- `is_account_admin` (Boolean) Account admins hold every permission on every cloud account, so their `role_assignments` is empty.
- `name` (String) Full name.
- `role_assignments` (Attributes List) Roles held, per cloud account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users--role_assignments))
- `status` (String) `ACTIVE` or `DISABLED`.

<a id="nestedatt--users--role_assignments"></a>
### Nested Schema for `users.role_assignments`

Read-Only:

- `cloud_provider_account_id` (String) AWS account ID, Azure subscription ID or GCP project ID.
- `display_name` (String) The cloud account's name in the Lucidity dashboard.
- `roles` (List of String) Role names, e.g. `Viewer`.
